node.reason: v5.28.0 adds Plan Attestation. reason: 5.28.0 ships Plan Attestation: plan_authorizations gains plan_hash + attest_* journal columns (drizzle/0075) and POST /api/plans/[planId]/attest becomes the run-start seam an unattended runner calls to prove its pinned authority is still approved, unexpired and unrevoked before its first model call. +1 API route, +1 Node SDK method, +1 Python SDK method (surface budget amended in THESIS.md and contracts/surface-budget.json in the same commit); zero new pages, zero new tables, zero new policy types. Both SDK sources changed and both ARE published this release via the v5.28.0 tag (release.yml, OIDC trusted publishing), so domains carries 'node' and 'python' alongside 'platform'. @dashclaw/cli is unchanged at 0.12.0 and its job skips.
